title: Speaking — Achieving a deadline
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on achieving a deadline.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
How do you keep track of upcoming deadlines?
Do you work steadily or do more work close to a deadline?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when you managed to finish an important task on time.
part2.closing: and explain how you would approach a similar task in future.

questions: When should an organisation grant extra time for tasks?
What problems can result from rewarding speed more than quality?
How has everyday life connected with achieving a deadline changed for people of different ages?
